name: pr-review
title: PR review
description: Start a session from a GitHub pull request, and pull the PR's existing comments into the session's own review UI. The first extension that claims a mode in the launcher (openFrom: "launcher") — GitHub belongs to a developer profile, not to every Arigami.

docs.description: Use when reviewing a GitHub pull request in this session — to pull the PR's existing review comments into the Changes tab, or to publish the review back. The session's metadata.prNumber names the PR.

agent.title: Review agent
agent.description: Slug of the agent a review session is born from (list_agents). Empty = a plain session. The agent is what makes this mode thin: it already carries the persona, the skills and the model.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: claude or codex — the CLI the review session runs on.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model for that engine (e.g. a claude alias, or gpt-5.6-terra for codex). Empty = the engine's default.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: low | medium | high | xhigh | max (codex also: ultra). Empty = the model's default.

reviewMode.title: Default checkout
reviewMode.description: worktree = check the PR out and review the code on disk. nocheckout = review from the diff alone, touching nothing.

promptTemplate.title: First-message template
promptTemplate.description: The first message of a review session. Placeholders: {{prUrl}} (the pull request URL) and {{checkout}} (a line saying whether the branch is checked out). Empty = the built-in prompt. You can still edit the message per review in the From PR tab.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Comma-separated owner/repo list to offer in the picker. Empty = ask gh for the ones you can push to.
